headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Samoa Joe vs. Darby Allin fought tooth and nail for the AEW TNT Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.08 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Joe powerbombed Allin onto the exposed concrete floor before finishing him off with the Coquina Clutch to retain the TNT Championship.
Looking back to 2024, when Mark Briscoe vs. Daniel Garcia met in a Continental Classic League Match, serving as the night's main event on Collision, rated 7.66 ? a solid showing.

Looking back to 2022, when The Acclaimed vs. FTR clashed for the AEW World Tag Team Titles, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.19 ? a real highlight of the night. The Acclaimed weathered a hungry FTR challenge, with Bowens' Mic Drop on Cash Wheeler sealing the win to retain the AEW World Tag Team Championship.
